title: guard step config
description: Classifier-backed input check that rejects the request, warns, or redacts the matched spans before generation.

model_id.description: Logical id of a published classifier model.

input_field.description: Context key to classify; prompt (or unset) means the request itself, inspected per scope, and any other key is classified alone.

scope.description: Turns inspected when the guard reads the request: last_user, user_turns, or conversation (every user, assistant and tool turn, system turns excluded); refused alongside any input_field other than prompt.

on_empty.description: What to do when there is no text to inspect: reject halts with the rendered message and skip passes to the next step; defaults to reject for the reject action and skip for warn and redact.

output_field.description: Redact only: context key receiving the redacted text (the original text when nothing matched); defaults to <step id>.redacted.

action.description: What happens when a trigger matches: reject halts the pipeline, warn flags and continues, redact masks the matched spans; the codec falls back to reject for unknown values.

trigger.description: Single trigger; ignored when triggers is non-empty.

triggers.description: Several triggers, any one of which fires the guard; wins over trigger.

message.description: Jinja template rendered on reject and returned as the failure message, with <step id>.label and <step id>.score available.

redact_with_entity_type.description: Redact only: replace each span with [LABEL] (upper-cased) instead of asterisks.

labels.description: Labels (entity types for a span model) to classify against, sent with every call in place of the model's own: names, or objects with a name and a description. Every trigger label must be one of them. Needs a zero-shot model (gliner_classifier, gliner_ner, or a decision model published as a classifier); any other model fails the pipeline load. Unset, the model's own labels apply.

trigger.description: A classifier label and the minimum score that fires it.

label.description: Classifier label to watch; one of labels when the step sets them.

score.description: Minimum score that fires the trigger; 0 means any score.

label.description: A label name, or an object with the name and a description.

name.description: The label, as the step's results, rules and triggers name it.

description.description: What the label means; the model reads it, so a precise sentence classifies better than a bare word.
